title: Output entries can be replayed to service endpoints
body:
It seems that it is possible to get in a state where we accept an output journal entry, but don't complete the invocation, if there is a crash at the exact time between the invocation journal entry and invocation end events are processed
The lack of atomicity is fine if, upon retry, we observe that the journal already has everything we need, so instead of replaying to service endpoint we simply skip straight to invocation completion

linked_prs.title: Modify the state handling of the end stream, moving the concern to the InvocationTask

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue describes a workflow anomaly in the agent system, specifically a failure in handling invocation completion and output replay due to non-atomic journal updates. Such workflow errors are agent-specific, fitting the "Workflow issues" category in the agent issue taxonomy.
